description: Where a phone learns of a newer build and fetches it, with no credential in the app (issue 192): the repository's public release feed, the address a release asset is served from, the names of the Android APK and its manifest on a release, and the two addresses that open TestFlight. The phone shells read the addresses from this file (the page loads nothing from the network), scripts/release names the Android assets it publishes from it, and core/test/phone-updates.test.js holds each side to it.
